background: HSBC Holdings is the listed holding company of HSBC, one of the world's largest banks, with its main earnings in Hong Kong and the UK and a global transaction banking, wealth and trade franchise.
synthesis: Two of the three main agencies rate the holding company, A on average with the weakest at A-, one on a positive outlook and one on a stable outlook; the last move was a one-notch downgrade by one of the three on 13 May 2020. Capital sits just above the UK majors median, with CET1 of 13.9% and leverage of 4.9%. Liquidity is mixed, LCR of 132% in the bottom quarter but NSFR of 139% in the top quarter. Since 30 Sep 2025 CET1 has fallen 0.6 points and NSFR 5 points (figures to 30 Sep 2026); the operating banks beneath it are rated higher.
